name: After recital D
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: Dc. whereas failing to adhere to a timeline that would enable the orientations of the new President of the French Republic, to be elected in the May 2027 elections, to be taken into account in the content of the MFF from the outset would create serious tensions that could still be avoided; whereas failing to provide such a timeline would, above all, reflect a manifest hostility towards French democracy, towards France as a major net contributor, and towards the French people, which would be difficult to justify;
